# fmc_cipher_suite_list (Resource)

This resource manages a Cipher Suite List.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "fmc_cipher_suite_list" "example" {
  name = "my_cipher_suite_list"
  cipher_suites = [
    {
      name = "TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cipher_suites` (Attributes Set) Set of predefined cipher suites which are part of the cipher suite list object. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cipher_suites))
- `name` (String) Name of the Cipher Suite List object.

### Optional

- `domain` (String) Name of the FMC domain

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Id of the object
- `type` (String) Type of the object; this value is always 'CipherSuiteList'.

<a id="nestedatt--cipher_suites"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cipher_suites`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the cipher suite.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <domain> is optional. If not provided, `Global` is used implicitly and resource's `domain` attribute is not set.
terraform import fmc_cipher_suite_list.example "<domain>,<id>"
```
